rdfs:label: PrimarySource
rdfs:comment: A qualified PROV Derivation stating that the source entity is a primary source for the derived one — produced by an agent with direct, first-hand experience of the topic (eyewitness account, raw measurement, original record).
notes: Subclass of `urn:solid:Derivation`. Types the derivation node (linked via `prov:qualifiedPrimarySource`), not the source document; to just say 'X's primary source is Y' use `urn:solid:hadPrimarySource`.

examples.title: Article based on a primary source

history.note: Clarified it types the derivation node, not the source document; removed attribution wording.
